comparison.objective: Knock an espresso puck from a portafilter and return the tool; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled impact and momentum transfer versus precision rotary adjustment, jam-nut tightening, and counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Puck in knock box and portafilter released on holder versus retained angle, nuts, repeated cycles, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Impact-based ejection is unrelated to coupled threaded locking.
